Planner gate runs — bump this file to start one.

run 8 — Part A1, PR #137. The per-call cap moves 3000 -> 4000 ms, set
the way the brief requires: from the measured p95 plus one second, not
from a round number. Run 7 measured 206 serial calls at

  fastest 537 · median 2273 · p95 2999.96 · slowest 3003 ms

and that p95 a hair under the old 3000 ms cap is the distribution being
clipped by it, not fitting inside it — 16 calls were truncated into
timeouts. Measured p95 + 1 s = 4000.

Run 7 also showed the provider itself varying: 5 x HTTP 503 "high
demand". Those fall back honestly and earn no retry, by design.
